title: DiBiPhil — Corpus of philosophical texts from Zeno's Digital Library
notes: Companion corpus of the Deutsches Textarchiv (BBAW), curated from the philosophical writings of Directmedia's Digitale Bibliothek on Zeno.org and encoded in DTABf/TEI; licence CC BY-SA 4.0. The whole corpus covers the 15th to 20th centuries; this entry covers its early modern texts, e.g. Böhme's 'Aurora oder Morgenröte im Aufgang' (1612) and Paracelsus treatises. The corpus can be searched at https://ddc.dwds.de/dstar/dibiphil/. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Deutsches Textarchiv (BBAW); source texts from Zeno.org's Digitale Bibliothek
